NUMTODSINTERVAL(#{staleRunMicros} / 1000000, 'SECOND') AND instr(',' || roles || ',', ',SCHEDULER,') > 0) AS active_scheduler_runs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ifj_cluster_state) AS cluster_state_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ifj_cluster_state WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= CAST(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP(3))) AS cluster_state_expired, COALESCE((SELECT GREATEST(0, TRUNC(GREATEST((CAST(CAST(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP(3)) AS DATE) -
